data.title: HRH the Crown Prince Congratulates Dr. Denis Bećirović on Taking Constitutional Oath as Member of Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Crown Prince and Prime Minister, sent a cable of congratulations to Dr. Denis Bećirović on taking the constitutional oath as a member of the Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
    HRH the Crown Prince extended his sincere congratulations and best wishes for his success and for further progress and advancement for the friendly people of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
    -- SPA
21:24 Local Time 18:24 GMT
